## Description

Post-implementation review of #2307 / #2300 at `main@c0a6f7417b93f8d8fd38047d08834f120f6ff5c1` found a **verified source-level response-body reconstruction defect** in `crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/mod.rs`. This is **not** the old #2300 UTF-8 `%output` reader defect: it happens **after byte framing**, while collecting the command's `%begin … %end` body.

At `OpenBlock::push`, the code uses `!self.body.is_empty()` as the predicate for inserting a separator. An empty first response line appends zero bytes, so subsequent lines cannot know a line was already seen. A response body containing one or multiple leading blank lines loses those lines. This is a distinct response-body framing root cause not covered by the earlier raw-pane-byte tests.

A **second, unproven risk** exists at `run_reader`: while a command response block is open, an unrecognized `%`-prefixed record is immediately treated as an unknown notification and skipped, even if it might be capture content. Do not assert tmux emits such content unescaped until the real `capture-pane -e` protocol is measured.

Relevant source:
- [client/mod.rs:650-676](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/c0a6f7417b93f8d8fd38047d08834f120f6ff5c1/crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/mod.rs#L650-L676)
- [client/mod.rs:745-761](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/c0a6f7417b93f8d8fd38047d08834f120f6ff5c1/crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/mod.rs#L745-L761)

### Prototype
- Decision: Not needed
- Reason / interaction uncertainty: internal capture correctness; no new product interaction.
- Status: Not needed

## Reproduction

1. In the existing real `TmuxClient` duplex harness, send a welcome pair and queue `CapturePane`.
2. Feed `%begin 2 1 0\n\nLINE\n%end 2 1 0\n`. Expected captured response is `b"\nLINE"`; the existing `OpenBlock::push` reconstructs `b"LINE"`. Repeat with multiple leading and embedded empty lines.
3. Feed literal `%`-prefixed capture candidates, `%output` interleaving and unknown notifications **separately**, then measure the actual tmux 3.6b `-C` and `-CC` output to decide what is capture data versus notifications. Do not rely on a synthetic protocol fixture alone for this ambiguity.
4. Verify `ControlModeSession::take_bootstrap` preserves the snapshot/live join and does not falsely claim full VT fidelity.

**Evidence status:** static code-path defect established; no newly executed red-before real-tmux witness claimed by this Issue.

## Root Cause

`OpenBlock::push` conflates “zero bytes accumulated” with “zero response lines observed”. Blank lines are semantically real data but the representation has no `has_line`/line-count state. The `%` notification/content distinction needs further protocol evidence; it is **not** asserted as a confirmed second root cause.

## Impact

Screen-only history/checkpoint capture can differ from the pane's actual text even with otherwise correct transport, Agent stream sequencing and renderer ACK. This must not be silently treated as byte-exact capture. Does not imply a new loss in ordinary live `%output` or claim an observed production corruption incident.

## Fix Direction

- Preserve response-body line boundaries explicitly, independent of byte length.
- Keep the tmux-notification parser and command-response-body ownership unambiguous; measure real tmux wire behavior before changing unknown-tag handling.
- Preserve known notifications, command reply order, timed-out-command tombstones, raw pane bytes, source loss and bounded response size.
- Extend **existing** Client/Control Mode tests and source-aligned real tmux Cases; avoid a new terminal emulator or duplicate Agent stream owner.

## Location

- `crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/mod.rs` — `run_reader`, `OpenBlock::push`
- `crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/tests.rs`
- `crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/control.rs`
- Existing Control Mode source-aligned Cases and terminal bootstrap E2E fixtures

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Deterministic red-before/green-after Control Mode reply tests prove leading, consecutive, embedded and trailing representable empty lines are reconstructed exactly, with bounded responses and correctly matched replies.
- [x] SC-02 Real isolated tmux `-C` and `-CC` capture Cases distinguish literal `%`-prefixed pane content from protocol notifications and preserve all supported capture bytes/line boundaries without breaking forward-compatible notifications.
- [x] SC-03 Capture/live interleaving and bootstrap recovery remain exactly-once and truthful about `screen-only`/partial fidelity, with no regression to `%output` byte integrity or command-response sequencing.

**Deduplication:** #2300 repaired UTF-8/raw `%output` framing; #2307 introduced the typed Client and proved its existing Cases. This report isolates a **different** response-body reconstruction mechanism found after those merges.
